what: TrustMRR (Marc Lou) became a marketplace; revenue doubled in 8 months. Previously $22.9k in Dec 2025, now higher as marketplace. Portfolio includes multiple products totaling high MRR.

what: Gojiberry AI hit $4.3M ARR in ~10 months from €0. AI agents that find & book meetings. Used own tool for growth (LinkedIn outreach, cold email 15k/day, Reddit, SEO).
why_us: Strong example of AI sales agent SaaS with self-reinforcing growth loop. Concrete playbook on high-intent outreach + content. High ARR validates demand for AI meeting bookers.

what: AI search visibility tool (how ChatGPT/Gemini/Claude/Perplexity talk about brands) almost hit $50k MRR. Category emerged in 1 year.
why_us: New category of AI SEO / brand monitoring in LLM responses. Companies paying for visibility insights. Signals demand for AI search analytics tools.

what: Friend built AI wrapper mobile app, crossed 50k Play Store downloads, revenue already exceeded previous salary. Generating profit.
why_us: Confirms AI wrappers can still hit traction and monetize on mobile despite saturation narrative. Low barrier, fast to revenue for some niches.

what: Ask HN: What is some software that you wish existed? Recent thread (4 days ago). Requests for open-source hardware video streamer (Roku-like), vein biometric authenticator, federated library management, open Spotify-like music desktop with MusicBrainz + yt-dlp.
why_us: Fresh HN demand signals for privacy/open alternatives to closed ecosystems (streaming, auth, media management). Repeatable theme of digital sovereignty tools.

what: Complaints on Trustpilot about AI app builders (Lovable, anything.com/createanything): expensive credits, unreliable output, no support, projects taken down, waste of money ($50-$1500 spent with zero usable result).
why_us: Clear pain in no-code/AI app generation tools: reliability, support, refund friction. Opportunity for more transparent, reliable, or refund-friendly AI coding platforms or better validation layers.
